item_name: Rothco Deluxe Vietnam Veteran Low Profile Shadow Caps
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Vietnam Veteran Low Profile Shadow Cap is a tribute to those who proudly served, combining style and comfort with thoughtful detailing. This rugged vet cap features a raised, 3-D embroidered “Vietnam Veteran” lettering and ribbon on the front center, alongside the bold text “Vietnam Vet” on the sandwich brim and shadow embroidery for added flair. Made from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, the baseball-styled hat provides a comfortable fit with an internal sweatband that helps keep you cool and dry.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Vietnam Veteran Low Profile Shadow Cap is a tribute to those who proudly served, combining style and comfort with thoughtful detailing. This rugged vet cap features a raised, 3-D embroidered “Vietnam Veteran” lettering and ribbon on the front center, alongside the bold text “Vietnam Vet” on the sandwich brim and shadow embroidery for added flair. Made from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, the baseball-styled hat provides a comfortable fit with an internal sweatband that helps keep you cool and dry. The adjustable hook & loop strap ensures that 1 size fits most, making it a perfect gift for any Vietnam veteran. Whether worn to show pride in service or as an everyday accessory, this rugged cap delivers both functionality and a meaningful connection to history. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
